children: Telomir Pharmaceuticals reported no revenue in 3Q 2026, as in the prior-year quarter, while its net loss narrowed. Lower toxicology, preclinical research and development-consultant costs, alongside higher professional expenses, shaped the quarter.
² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Basic and diluted net loss per share attributable to common stockholders”.
: FDA cleared the IND application to initiate a clinical trial in advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.
: The April merger with TELI consolidated exclusive worldwide rights to develop and commercialize Telomir-Zn.
: Quarterly R&D expense declined, primarily reflecting lower toxicology, preclinical research and consultant costs.
: An October private placement generated approximately $5.7 million in gross proceeds for clinical development, working capital and general corporate purposes.
